purpose: Curated free-asset candidates for NG first-playable evaluation. Download into local asset_eval/downloads only; do not commit raw third-party binaries without review.

license_policy.notes: For first playable, prefer CC0 audio/UI/placeholder art. Do not promote any asset without a source URL, license ID, and manifest entry.

candidates.name: Kenney UI Pack
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for placeholder panels, buttons, sliders, and basic menu UI parts.
candidates.notes: Likely useful for prototype UI only; style may be too clean for final low-fantasy UI.

candidates.name: Kenney UI Pack RPG Expansion
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for RPG-flavored UI widgets, inventory-style panels, and quest/log placeholders.
candidates.notes: High-value candidate for first-playable UI placeholders.

candidates.name: Kenney UI Audio
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for UI click, hover, confirm, cancel, and quest-log placeholder sounds.
candidates.notes: Small audio assets are easier to adopt permanently than mismatched art.

candidates.name: Kenney Interface Sounds
candidates.notes: Potentially redundant with UI Audio; evaluate both and keep the least intrusive set.

candidates.name: Kenney RPG Audio
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for footsteps, weapon, and low-key interaction placeholder sounds.
candidates.notes: Good fit for first-playable feel if sounds are subtle enough.

candidates.name: Kenney Impact Sounds
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for combat prototype hits, object impacts, and blocked-action sounds.
candidates.notes: More useful once combat prototype starts.

candidates.name: Kenney Game Icons
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for placeholder action, controller, prompt, and UI icons.
candidates.notes: Probably useful for debug/prototype prompts, less likely final.

candidates.name: Kenney Board Game Icons
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for inventory, quest, map, and condition icons.
candidates.notes: May contain symbols useful for CRPG abstractions.

candidates.name: Kenney Roguelike/RPG Pack
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate for placeholder inventory icons, object silhouettes, and debug map tokens.
candidates.notes: Pixel style likely mismatches final pseudo-isometric art, but useful for prototypes.

candidates.name: itch.io CC0 Godot Asset Pool
candidates.expected_use: Discovery pool for Godot-tagged CC0 candidates. Evaluate individual pages before download.
candidates.notes: Do not assume every linked pack is suitable; each page needs individual license/source review.

candidates.name: Bit Bonanza - Simple Top-Down 10x10 RPG Assets Tileset
candidates.expected_use: Evaluate small RPG item/entity silhouettes for placeholder icons or debug tokens.
candidates.notes: Useful mostly as prototype/debug material; 1-bit/10x10 style does not match final art direction.

candidates.name: Godot Asset Library Discovery Pool
candidates.expected_use: Discovery pool for editor plugins, import helpers, debug tools, and small utilities.
candidates.notes: Review licenses carefully. Prefer permissive plugins; avoid frameworks that replace NG systems.
